values.note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, June 2027: Water/Electric RV Site $50 on a Tuesday, $75 on a Saturday; Water/Electric/Sewer $60 / $90 (both types sold to Class A/B/C motorhomes). No per-night fee on the quote, only the park's $5 'Reservation Fee' once per stay (read 2026-10-13). Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children; visitors pay a fee at the Ranger Station. A campsite cancelled 2+ weeks out is refunded less a $35 booking fee, the $5 reservation fee and any site-lock fee. Early check-in or late check-out $35. Campspot offered no sites in October 2026 or January 2027.
